name: Transition To Tech
description: Complete career transition workflow for professionals from non-technical backgrounds who want to enter the technology industry. Covers honest self-assessment and role discovery, building technical skills through structured learning, creating a portfolio that demonstrates competence, applying strategically, and landing your first tech role. Use when the user wants to transition to tech or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
